Regulatory frameworks designed by tech giants to cement their market dominance under safety pretexts.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing the WHO (independent public regulators) with the WHO (industry-vetted private labs sharing founder roots with AI firms).

Social Physics Analysis:
Actors execute a Smart Selfish Maneuver by framing commercial moat-building as existential altruism. They project safety urgency to invite regulations that sideline upstart competitors while preserving corporate control.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated safety intentions and incumbent-protecting results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Net force vector pulls ψ negative as self-interest replaces public oversight.

The Unavoidable Truth: Industry-backed AI watchdogs are designed to preserve incumbent market dominance.

The Unavoidable Lie: Independent testing labs operate entirely free from corporate capture and ideological bias.
